diffs.diff: pm2_5_ugm3: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Plantower PMS5003 data manual V2.3, Appendix I: 'Data2 refers to PM2.5 concentration unit μg/m3 (CF=1, standard particle)' and 'Data 5 refers to PM2.5 concentration unit μg/m3 (under atmospheric environment)'; spec table 'Resolution 1 μg/m³'. So the 16-bit word is the concentration directly, 1 μg/m³ per count, offset 0. The model already encodes exactly this: sim.uartStream sends control 'value' (PM2.5, µg/m³) as a 16-bit word with scale 1 at both Data2 and Data5, and the driver returns w[4] (Data 5) unscaled as pm2_5. The gate reports 'none' only because its authorConversions() reads sim.measure/measures/responses/analog, not sim.uartStream; the constants agree (1 vs 1).
